KeyPassages: Esther 1:5; Esther 7:7; Esther 7:8; Song of Solomon 6:11
BiblicalUsage: ginnâh is the word for garden. I meet it 4 times across the Bible, and Esther is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ginnâh matters because God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
